title: Terms & Conditions

p: These terms apply to everyone who visits or uses the Hayaati Web Technology website (the "website"), including the Jarvis assistant, the guided tours, coupons, guest codes and the forms on the website. By using the website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.

The website is a creative preview of future technology from 2030 to 2050. Eras, technologies, places, vehicles, devices and images shown here are concepts and illustrations. They are not products for sale, and nothing on the website is a promise that any of them will exist.
The website is still being built. Sections, features and limits may change, be added or be removed at any time.

Jarvis is an artificial intelligence assistant. It answers by voice or chat and can move around the website for you. Its answers are generated automatically and may sometimes be incomplete or wrong. Jarvis does not give professional, medical, legal or financial advice; please do not rely on it for decisions of that kind.

Voice conversations use your microphone only after your browser asks and you allow it. To answer you, what you say or type is processed by our AI service provider. Please do not share passwords, payment details or other sensitive personal information with Jarvis.
Some owner-only features of Jarvis are protected and can never be opened by voice.

Usage limits apply to each visitor and are counted per browser and connection. A voice conversation ends automatically when its time is up. When a limit is reached, Jarvis lets you know and you can continue later.
Jarvis also shares one daily capacity across all visitors. On a very busy day voice conversations and tours may pause until the next day, even if you have not reached your own limit.

list: Each visitor can request one free coupon per year ("first time free").
A coupon unlocks one Premium Tour. It is used up the moment the tour starts and cannot be used again.
A coupon belongs to the browser that requested it and cannot be transferred, shared, sold or exchanged for money.
An unused coupon expires 60 days after it was issued.
If a tour cannot connect at all right after it starts, the coupon is given back automatically.
A tour that has started and is stopped early by the visitor, or ends because its time is up, uses the coupon.

p: Guest codes are personal invitations from Hayaati Web Technology. A guest code works once, on one browser. Today it unlocks one Premium Tour without a coupon; other guest benefits may be added later. Guest codes may be switched off at any time and have no cash value.
When using the website, please do not:
list: try to get around usage limits, coupons, guest codes or owner verification;
use bots or automated tools to send messages, ratings, forms or voice sessions;
try to break, overload or gain unauthorised access to the website or its services;
use Jarvis or the forms to send abusive, unlawful, harmful or misleading content;
copy or reuse the website's design, images, text or code without permission.
after: Access may be limited or blocked for anyone who breaks these rules.

p: When you send a rating, the contact form or the advertising form, the information you enter (for example your message, and your name and email if you give them) is used to read your feedback and to reply to you. Ratings and feedback may be used to improve the website.

The website, its design, images, animations, text, the Jarvis experience and the Hayaati name belong to Hayaati Web Technology and are protected by copyright and other laws. You may view the website for personal, non-commercial use. Any other use needs written permission.

The website and Jarvis are provided "as is" and "as available". They may sometimes be slow, unavailable or behave differently on some devices and browsers. For the best experience, keep your browser and phone updated.
To the extent allowed by law, Hayaati Web Technology is not responsible for any loss arising from use of the website, Jarvis or information shown on it.
These terms may be updated as the website grows. The date at the top shows the latest version. Using the website after a change means you accept the updated terms.
